theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨q', hq, hh⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL hq, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨p', hp, hh⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL hp, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim hb =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨q', hq, hh⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨q', hq, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨p', hp, hh⟩ := hb.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨p', hp, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩

  constructor

    intro s1' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
        · constructor

      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · assumption
      constructor
      apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
  case right =>

    cases r

        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s2'
        constructor
